name: Julio Altartosk
source:
Julio is a spirited young man. He lives in the peaceful village of Ithaca, where his constant enthusiasm has won over the hearts of the other residents. He works in the fields under the supervision of the god Esus’s disciples, though he chafes at his obligations; over time, he has become an expert at outwitting them to sneak off for a quick nap with total impunity.

Possessing a sharp sense of humor, he is always up for a laugh and excels at pranks and impersonations—much to the delight of those around him, who are often the targets of his antics. Despite his carefree nature, Julio is deeply sensitive, particularly when faced with injustice. It was this glimmer of hope for meaningful change that led the god Yggdrasill to choose him as his protégé.
